tara: rolled bluejay-lite-v1 (int6) into staging vectors for onboarding. quick run shows recall@1 down ~0.03 on conversational-short holdout. posting quick outputs, anyone free to eyeball?
ben: paste the eval command + numbers pls.
tara: command i ran:
```
./scripts/run_embedding_eval.sh --model bluejay-lite-v1 --quant int6 --dataset conversational-short --index hnsw --ef 150 --norm unit
```
summary snippet:
```
baseline fp32: recall@1=0.895
bluejay int6 (default per-tensor): recall@1=0.865  # -0.030
recall@5: 0.957 -> 0.943
median_rank: 1 -> 2
```
leo: three quick suspects: per-tensor vs per-channel, missing/duplicated normalization, or ANN params (ef/metric). also which quant backend? our-runtime or onnx?
maya: also try a small probe: compute cosine similarity distributions for 1k queries between fp32 and quant; if distribution compressed that's a tell.
eval-bot: regression-detected: recall@1 delta=-0.030 on dataset=conversational-short vs baseline. severity=medium. ticket=ML-5012
tara: it's our-runtime int6-per-tensor default. i re-ran with per-channel int6 and ef=350 and disabled explicit --norm (to use stored pipeline):
```
./scripts/run_embedding_eval.sh --model bluejay-lite-v1 --quant int6 --quant-mode per-channel --dataset conversational-short --index hnsw --ef 350 --norm none --export-hist=pairwise_delta.csv
```
new results:
```
recall@1=0.891
recall@5=0.955
median_rank=1.1
pairwise delta median=0.018 (was 0.055)
```
ben: nice recovery. sounds like per-tensor quant was compressing dims unevenly and harming neighbor structure. ef help also suggests top-k ordering was marginally recoverable.
leo: action items: 1) update model catalog default for bluejay-lite-v1 to int6-per-channel, 2) add a CI smoke that runs conversational-short with ef=300 and asserts recall@1 >= fp32-0.02, 3) export pairwise-delta hist in onboarding artifacts for quick triage. i'll open the PR for the smoke test and catalog tweak.
maya: one more ask: add a small UMAP snapshot and silhouette score to the onboarding artifact set for cluster-style datasets. sometimes recall hides topology change.
eval-bot: note added to ticket ML-5012: request artifacts {pairwise_delta.csv, umap_snapshot.png, silhouette.txt}.
tara: kick off a 6-seed stability sweep (varying RNG + HNSW seeds) and will upload aggregated metrics in the morning. thanks all. :pray:
